subject: Thanks for handling the travel disruption
text:
Thanks for stepping in during the travel disruption. I know the original plan was already complicated because the venue changed rooms at the last minute, but you kept the schedule from falling apart without making anyone feel panicked. That mattered more than I realized at the time.

When the train was cancelled and you had to call the caterer, the vendor rep, and the local guide within ten minutes, I saw how much pressure you were under. You did not complain, you did not blame anyone, and you simply solved the problem one step at a time. That is rare, and I appreciate it.

I also wanted to say that your judgment protected my authority as organizer. When questions started arriving at once, you answered with enough detail to reassure people, but you did not overcomplicate the situation. That balance helped the room stay focused on the program rather than the logistics, which is exactly what we needed while the travel details were unsettled. I will not forget how quickly you restored confidence, especially for the people joining remotely and relying on your updates to know that nothing was falling through the cracks.

Your message this morning also gave the team a calmer path forward. The attendees noticed the smooth transitions, but I noticed the quiet effort behind them. I would like to buy you coffee next week to thank you properly, not because we need another meeting, but because you deserve a short pause after all that.

Thanks,
Jordan
